{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Strip commas from revenue and convert to float
# First, confirm no commas are present in the string values
print("\nSample of revenue values before cleaning:")
print(df['revenue'].head(10))

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Verify the transformation
print("\nSample of revenue_clean after cleaning:")
print(df['revenue_clean'].head(10))

# Check for any remaining non-numeric values
print("\nAny non-numeric values in revenue_clean?", df['revenue_clean'].isna().sum())"}
